Search official KNBS publications

Source: R/publications.R
knbs_publications.Rd

Searches the documents in the KNBS website's media library: statistical releases, survey reports, the Economic Survey and other published files.

Usage

knbs_publications(
  query = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  format = NULL,
  limit = 100,
  source = NULL,
  cache = knbs_option("cache"),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

query

Free-text search over titles and descriptions.

year

Keep only publications whose title names this year, or a range c(from, to).

format

Keep only these file formats: any of "pdf", "xlsx", "xls", "docx", "csv", "zip".

limit

Maximum number of records to return (at most 100).

source

Source id. Defaults to the first verified publications source.

cache

Whether to use the local cache.

refresh

Whether to bypass any cached response.

Value

A knbs_catalogue tibble with columns publication_id, title, year, release_date, modified, description, format, file_size, file_name, download_url, landing_page, source_id, checksum and access.

Details

Two honesty notes about this source. First, release_date is the date the file was uploaded to the site, not the publication's reference period; the year column is read from the title, and is NA when the title names none. Second, the media library also holds speeches, launch remarks and forms — narrowing to what you mean is the job of query and format.

The source ignores its own file-type parameter (audit F-22), so the format filter is applied by the package — and because a page of recent uploads may contain no matches at all, supplying format makes the search page back through older uploads until it has limit matches or the matches are exhausted. Expect a format-filtered search to take a few seconds longer than a plain one.

The reference-year filter is applied to the title-derived year, after retrieval. With a narrow query this is exact; with a broad one it filters only within the records retrieved.

See also

knbs_download_publication()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
knbs_publications("economic survey")
knbs_publications("consumer price", format = "xlsx")
knbs_publications("census", year = c(2019, 2023))
} # }
